import httpx
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from starlette.requests import Request
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse


async def unfurl(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    """Build a link card (title, description, image) for a pasted URL."""
    target = request.query_params.get("url")
    if not target:
        return JSONResponse({"error": "url is required"}, status_code=400)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        resp = await client.get(target)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")
    og = {m.get("property"): m.get("content") for m in soup.find_all("meta") if m.get("property")}
    return JSONResponse({
        "title": og.get("og:title") or (soup.title.string if soup.title else None),
        "description": og.get("og:description"),
        "image": og.get("og:image"),
    })

notes: Starlette unfurl fetches query-param URL with httpx, no allow-list
Django webhook test posts to user URL; startswith('https://') is not validation

import urllib.request

from rest_framework import serializers, status
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView

from podcasts.feeds import parse_rss


class FeedImportSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    feed_url = serializers.URLField()


class ImportFeedView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        ser = FeedImportSerializer(data=request.data)
        ser.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        feed_url = ser.validated_data["feed_url"]
        with urllib.request.urlopen(feed_url, timeout=10) as fh:
            episodes = parse_rss(fh.read())
        return Response({"episodes": len(episodes)}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

async def repo_summary(request: Request) -> JSONResponse:
    owner = request.path_params["owner"]
    repo = request.path_params["repo"]
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.github_token}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=GITHUB_API, headers=headers, timeout=5) as client:
        r = await client.get(f"/repos/{quote(owner, safe='')}/{quote(repo, safe='')}")
        r.raise_for_status()
        data = r.json()
    return JSONResponse({"stars": data["stargazers_count"], "open_issues": data["open_issues_count"]})

from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from aiohttp import ClientSession, web

ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"www.youtube.com", "vimeo.com", "open.spotify.com"}
OEMBED = {
    "www.youtube.com": "https://www.youtube.com/oembed",
    "vimeo.com": "https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json",
    "open.spotify.com": "https://open.spotify.com/oembed",
}


async def oembed(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    link = request.query.get("url", "")
    parts = urlsplit(link)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname not in ALLOWED_HOSTS:
        raise web.HTTPBadRequest(text="unsupported provider")
    async with ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(OEMBED[parts.hostname], params={"url": link, "format": "json"}, allow_redirects=False) as r:
            payload = await r.json()
    return web.json_response({"html": payload.get("html"), "title": payload.get("title")})

notes: urlsplit + scheme/hostname allow-list before request
resolves host and rejects private/loopback/link-local IPs before requests.post

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Operator tool: report broken links in a sitemap. Usage: check_links.py <sitemap-url>"""
import argparse
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import requests

NS = {"sm": "http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9"}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("sitemap_url")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    tree = ET.fromstring(requests.get(args.sitemap_url, timeout=10).content)
    broken = 0
    for loc in tree.findall(".//sm:loc", NS):
        r = requests.head(loc.text, allow_redirects=True, timeout=10)
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            broken += 1
            print(f"{r.status_code} {loc.text}")
    return 1 if broken else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

notes: CLI operator script; URL from argv

import jsonpickle
from aiohttp import WSMsgType, web

from collab.board import apply_operation


async def board_socket(request: web.Request) -> web.WebSocketResponse:
    ws = web.WebSocketResponse(heartbeat=20)
    await ws.prepare(request)
    board_id = request.match_info["board_id"]
    async for msg in ws:
        if msg.type != WSMsgType.TEXT:
            continue
        op = jsonpickle.decode(msg.data)
        result = await apply_operation(board_id, op)
        await ws.send_str(jsonpickle.encode(result))
    return ws

notes: jsonpickle.decode on websocket client messages

import pickle

import redis

from analytics.settings import REDIS_URL

_r = redis.Redis.from_url(REDIS_URL)
_TTL = 15 * 60


def cached_dashboard(org_id: int, build):
    """Cache the computed dashboard frame in this service's private Redis."""
    key = f"analytics:dashboard:{org_id}"
    hit = _r.get(key)
    if hit is not None:
        return pickle.loads(hit)
    frame = build(org_id)
    _r.setex(key, _TTL, pickle.dumps(frame, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL))
    return frame

notes: pickle round-trip in the service's own cache

import hashlib
import hmac
import os

ITERATIONS = 600_000


def hash_passphrase(passphrase: str) -> tuple[bytes, bytes]:
    salt = os.urandom(16)
    digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", passphrase.encode(), salt, ITERATIONS)
    return salt, digest


def verify_passphrase(passphrase: str, salt: bytes, expected: bytes) -> bool:
    digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", passphrase.encode(), salt, ITERATIONS)
    return hmac.compare_digest(digest, expected)

notes: pbkdf2_hmac random salt 600k iterations

from weather.config import settings

BASE = "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"


async def daily_forecast(lat: float, lon: float) -> list[dict]:
    params = {
        "latitude": round(lat, 3),
        "longitude": round(lon, 3),
        "daily": "temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum",
        "timezone": "auto",
